study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Wu and Baeken, Biological Psychiatry: Global Open Science, 2024
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Sex Determines Anterior Cingulate Cortex Cortical Thickness in the Course of Depression

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study used data from the REST-meta-MDD Consortium (also referred to as the DIRECT consortium), which consists of 25 research groups in 17 hospitals in China. For the current ACC CT study, participants were selected from 9 study sites after applying quality and exclusion criteria.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "Structural brain imaging data were used from the REST-MetaMDD Consortium (35), which consists of 25 research groups in 17 hospitals in China." "Consequently, 499 patients with MDD (381 first-episode MDD, 118 recurrent MDD) and 524 HCs with an age range of 12 to 77 years were selected from 9 study sites."
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Wu2024.pdf.md: Methods and Materials / Participants, L35-L39

answer.REST-meta-MDD: source of both healthy control data for normative modeling and patient data for clinical research (first-episode MDD, recurrent MDD, and healthy controls)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: The REST-meta-MDD dataset provided both the healthy control group (N=524) used to build the normative model via Hierarchical Bayesian regression (PCNToolkit v0.18) and the patient groups (first-episode MDD N=381, recurrent MDD N=118) for clinical comparison. The normative model generated z-scores (deviations from the norm) for each participant's ACC cortical thickness.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "we also applied neuroanatomical normative modeling to capture individual-level variability in ACC CT, performed within the PCNToolkit (version 0.18) package... Hierarchical Bayesian regression analysis was employed to accommodate intersite variation and generate normative models using the covariates of sex, age, and education. The deviations (z statistics) for each participant that quantify the degree of an individual's CT differences from the norm were computed and submitted for the above statistical analysis."
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Wu2024.pdf.md: Methods and Materials / Statistical Analysis, L69

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: The HC group had a mean age of 36.77 years (SD=14.18). The age range of 12-77 years is reported for the entire selected sample (MDD + HC combined), so min/max for HCs specifically is inferred from the overall sample range. Females had a mean age of 37.79 (SD=14.45) and males 35.05 (SD=13.57). No train/test split for the normative model is explicitly described.
